steps.title: Ratings loader
steps.goal: Load MovieLens ratings into a user-item matrix.
acceptance: Ratings loader has a passing test
rubric: Explains why the user-item matrix is sparse and why that matters for memory.
Explains how missing ratings differ from zero ratings.
Explains how the loader would be checked for duplicate or malformed rows.

steps.title: KNN recommender core
steps.goal: Recommend five films for a user from their nearest neighbours.
acceptance: KNN recommender core has a passing test
rubric: Explains that mean-centring removes each user's rating bias before similarity is computed.
Explains why cosine similarity suits sparse rating vectors better than raw Euclidean distance.
Explains how the choice of k trades noise against over-smoothing.
Explains the cold-start problem for a user with no ratings.

steps.title: Offline evaluation
steps.goal: Measure precision@5 on a held-out split.
acceptance: Offline evaluation has a passing test
rubric: Explains why ratings are held out per user rather than at random across all users.
Explains what precision@5 measures and what it misses.
Explains how to tell whether a change actually improved the recommender.
